module: Editor tool "Asset Management Tool" (Window > Assets menu, 1200x900 window) for managing asset files and link files (for BeamNG's SVN repository). Tabs: Duplicated Assets (only visible in devMode), Link Checker, Delinker, Relinker, Link Files Cleanup, Naming Checker. It relies on FS:hashFile, FS:findLinkFiles, FS:convertLinkFileToTargetCopy, FS:copyFile, etc. Internal development tool, of little use to a mod.
notes: The Duplicated Assets tab requires devMode and the userpath to be identical to the game path (command line option -nouserpath), otherwise it shows a warning.
Only onEditorInitialized, onEditorActivated, onEditorGui and onExtensionLoaded are exported; the onWindowMenuItem function stays local (used by the menu).
The game data folders considered are /art, /core, /campaigns, /levels, /protected, /vehicles.

onEditorActivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is activated; empty body.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every editor frame: draws the tabbed window (Duplicated Assets if devMode, Link Checker, Delinker, Relinker, Link Files Cleanup, Naming Checker) and the associated modal dialogs (e.g. confirmation to remove assets from the list).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the 'assetManagementTool' window and its ~15 modal windows, adds the "Asset Management Tool" menu entry (Assets group) and loads the saved duplicates list (loadDuplicatesList).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is loaded; empty body.
